title: Per-command contract for a cross-stream changeset (validate and check pass, preview rejects)
expectation: One changeset file whose targets cross changelog streams—a default-stream feat on @acme/api and user-stream feature on @acme/ui—passes monochange step validate and monochange check because those commands do not resolve streams. Of the three commands exercised here, preview rejects the file with exit 1, changeset targets resolve to multiple changelog streams, and the corrective split the changes into one file per stream message. Release preparation also resolves streams and rejects this invalid intent. Splitting the targets into one file per stream lets preview accept the plan; these mechanical command properties are tested without a model.

setupFiles..changeset/mixed-stream.md:
---
"@acme/api": feat
"@acme/ui": feature
---

One file carrying both the developer refactor and the customer-facing feature, which is exactly the trap.

checks.why: The trap: `step validate` only parses frontmatter and resolves targets, so a cross-stream file passes it and the author sees no problem.
The lint pass does not resolve streams either, so `check` accepting the file must not be read as release readiness.

expectOutput: changeset targets resolve to multiple changelog streams
split the changes into one file per stream
checks.why: Release planning is where stream separation is enforced, and the error must name both the problem and the remedy.

checks.command:
rm .changeset/mixed-stream.md
cat > .changeset/api-feat.md <<'EOF'
---
"@acme/api": feat
---

Internal request builder refactor for SDK maintainers.
EOF
cat > .changeset/ui-feature.md <<'EOF'
---
"@acme/ui": feature
---

Copy link button on the profile screen.
EOF
monochange preview --format json >/dev/null 2>&1
rc=$?
rm -f .changeset/api-feat.md .changeset/ui-feature.md
exit $rc
checks.why: The positive half of the contract: one stream per file is sufficient, so `preview` plans the group once the audiences are split.
